HtmlDescription:
BMX / Freestyle.
Full set (Rotor + cables). FISHBONE X-UFO Spectra.
(Suitable for fork Ref. 11964)
With this rotor you can give as many turns as you want to the handlebar without braking the wheel, or breaking anything.

- Strong and durable
- Simple assembly
- Minimal maintenance.
- For 1" (25.4mm) fork tubes.
